$description: Wellness Lamp v1 design tokens. W3C design-token format: convert to src/design-system/tokens/*.ts. Sizes are dp, type sizes sp. Components use these names only, never raw values. Source: FINAL (all screens) and DESIGN_SYSTEM.md. Motion tokens (durations, easings, orb and wash values) are in the motion group; see MOTION.md.

charcoal.$description: Filled buttons, selected chips, slider knob, outline-button border

text-muted.$description: Secondary text everywhere; Undo / Redo, the pencil; the off switch's ring and thumb

text-muted-strong.$description: Home's 'Tonight' label and the scene's line, over the wash

text-disabled.$description: Label or icon of any disabled button

problem.$description: Connection problems and their fixes ('Try again')

surface.$description: Cycle key, search field, round buttons, selected and playing rows; a disabled filled button's fill and border

surface-strong.$description: The Me button's circle (every tab), the Cycle key while cycling, play / pause pressed

outline.$description: Slider track (unfilled), the naming sheet's field border, the Cycle key's edge line while cycling

outline-faint.$description: Brightness ring ticks, chip borders, a disabled outline button's border

pressed.$description: Pressed state of every tappable, laid over it by the shared Pressable wrapper (ink at 6%)

busy.$description: A button that is waiting ("Setting the scene…"): its fill, with an ink label (ink at 8%)

serif.$description: Titles, tabs, 'Set at'. Weight 400 only. Bundle the font (OFL).

sans.$description: Everything you operate. Weights 400 / 500 / 600. Bundle the font (OFL).

display.$description: Home's title, the result's mood name; long names step down to headline, then title. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(34 x 1.06) = 36.

headline.$description: Page and screen titles (Library, Remote, Sound, Light, Scent), the scene view's current name. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(28 x 1.143) = 32.

title.$description: The Remote's scene name, the current heading tab, the naming sheet's title. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(24 x 1.25) = 30.

title-small.$description: Year headings, empty-state lines. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(20 x 1.3) = 26.

tab.$description: The other heading tabs, 'Set at 22:10', month names. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(16 x 1.25) = 20.

body.$description: Home's line, name fields. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(16 x 1.5) = 24.

body-strong.$description: Names in rows, every button label, switch labels, All, values. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(16 x 1.25) = 20.

heading.$description: Card headings (Light › Sound › Scent ›), the now-playing name. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(16 x 1.25) = 20.

small.$description: Second lines in rows, sound and scent lines. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(14 x 1.43) = 20.

small-strong.$description: Category labels, Cycle, Undo. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(14 x 1.43) = 20.

caption.$description: Dates, hints, small labels (some at 500: keep the weight). lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(13 x 1.385) = 18.

caption-strong.$description: Group headings, field headings. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(13 x 1.385) = 18.

status.$description: The connection line and its fix, beside Me. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(12 x 1.333) = 16.

micro.$description: Calendar dates and weekday letters, year-view days. lineHeight is a ratio: React Native lineHeight = round(12 x 1.333) = 16.

full.$description: Half the element's height: dots, orbs, round buttons, switches, pills, chips, Cycle key, search field

row.$description: Rows, name fields, the message bar, year-view month tiles

sheet.$description: Top corners of the naming sheet

screen-margin.$description: Left and right margin on phones 360 dp and wider; 16 below 360 (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, Layout)

button-row.$description: Height of a button inside a row or the Remote's bottom group

orb-home.$description: Home's, the result's and the scene view's orb at a 360 dp screen width; scales with width (Layout)

content-max.$description: Widest the content column gets; centred beyond that

dimmed.$description: Things you can't act on right now (category tabs while searching, future months) and a part's controls while that part is off. Never on a control that works (Choose).

motion.$description: Durations are ms. Curves are cubic-bezier [x1, y1, x2, y2] unless the description names a function in animation-reference/easing.ts. MOTION.md sections 5 to 8 say where each is used. Never put a raw number in a component.

tap.$description: Set the scene press; neighbour orbs fade in during a drag

fade.$description: Screen-group cross-fades, Not now, the pause after Reading your answers

slide.$description: Scene strip slide: clamp(300, 520 - abs(velocity) * 160, 460); taps use 460

slide-snap.$description: Snap-back when a drag is released short

text-swap.$description: Scene text out and in during a slide

wash-cross.$description: Scene view wash cross-fade between scenes, and brighten 0.40 to 0.50

wash-in.$description: Home wash bleeds in from the outer edges

wash-reduced.$description: Home wash fade with Remove animations

wash-start.$description: Home wash starts this long after Set the scene (200 with Remove animations)

long-exposure.$description: Reading your answers: pearl develops into the mood palette

long-exposure-done.$description: 3700 plus the 450 pause: the result appears

long-exposure-reduced.$description: Plain colour blend with Remove animations

cycle-colour.$description: One colour of the orb walk at speed 1

value-hide.$description: Brightness / volume % label stays this long after release

undo-window.$description: Message bar visible; Undo live (Home, Library)

set-wait.$description: Set the scene: "Setting the scene…" before the scene is sent (Home and the scene view)

screen-push.$description: The Remote's Light / Sound / Scent screens slide in from the right, and out on Back

strip.$description: Scene strip slide, snap-back, name emphasis

open.$description: Scene view open, month / year zoom, a Remote screen sliding in

push-out.$description: A Remote screen sliding out on Back

soft.$description: easing.ts: (1 - cos(pi * x^0.75)) / 2. Every orb grow

sine.$description: easing.ts: (1 - cos(pi * x)) / 2. Every orb settle

canvas-ratio.$description: Orb diameter / canvas side: the canvas holds the halo

scale-rest.$description: On now: at rest after Set the scene

hit-radius.$description: A press counts within this x the orb size of its centre

remote-opacity-off.$description: Light off: pearl at this opacity

opacity-home.$description: Home wash strength: a little more colour than the scene view at rest (0.40)

opacity-scene-lit.$description: Scene view wash after Set the scene

inset.$description: The wash is drawn this fraction past every screen edge

text-on-wash.$description: Muted text while a wash is on (same as color.text-muted-strong)
